name: Agreed, not booked
title: Agreed, not booked: a next meeting agreed in one of your meetings that is not in your calendar, in the morning brief, with Book it

events.booked: You pressed Book it on a next meeting the morning brief said was agreed and not in your calendar
events.not_needed: You pressed Not needed on a next meeting the morning brief said was agreed and not in your calendar

runs.shown: Rouh put next meetings that were agreed and not in your calendar in the morning brief

permissions: reads the meetings from the meeting library and the events of your own calendars in your Master, over the last six weeks
puts an event on your usual calendar, inviting the guests of the meeting it was agreed in, only when you press Book it
touches.remove: Turn the switch next_meeting off on its row in Evolution, Mutations, and the section is gone; to remove it for good revert night 20's commit (rouh/next_meeting.py, the brief_next_meeting route and its lines in rouh/web/brief.py and rouh/project/urls.py, drawNextMeeting and its helpers in briefpage.js, this manifest) and delete the user setting next_meeting. Events already booked stay in the calendar.
